title: Regiments of Believers in Paradise
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Allah, Allah.
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, yaa Sultan al-Awliya. Madad, yaa RijaalAllah.
Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa habeebuhu wa rasooluh (s).
Awda`na hadhihi 'l-kalimatayn `indak, yaa Sayyidee, yaa Rasoolullah, wa hum lana wadi`atun yawma 'lqiyamah yaa man arsalahullahu ta`ala rahmatan lil-`alameen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) Allah Allah,

SubhaanAllah. Allah Allah, Sultan Allah. Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah. Allah Allah, SubhaanAllah. Allah
Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah. Allahu akbar wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Madad yaa RijaalAllah, madad yaa Saahib
al Imdaad, yaa Sultaan al-Awliya, yaa Hadrati Shaykhuna Sultaan al-Awliya, madad, madad, madad!
And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem.
Welcome to you! Welcome to those people who are coming to the way of Paradise. Angels are saying,
“Welcome, welcome, welcome!” Angels are giving salutes and salaams to whom coming on the way reaching
to Paradise. Welcome! Angels welcoming then Sayyidina Ridwaan (a), who is the angel looking for whole
Paradises, Sayyidina Ridwaan, peace be upon him, is opening eight doors, entrances for servants of the Lord
of Heavens saying, “Welcome, welcome, welcome!"

If the whole nation of Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) is not entering one-after-one, but
if whole ummati Muhammad (s) may be on one line, no need for one going and second one going after him,
no. Coming on the Day of Resurrection, the Day of Judgment, whole nations from Adam (a), whole nations
going to be 120 saff, lines. One part of 120 lines, 40 is going to be for whole nations from Adam (a). And for
the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidi ‘r-rusuli ‘l-Kiraam, going to be 80 lines; 80 regiments belong to the Seal of
Prophets (s)! And really all of them are under his holy flag, the Liwaa’i 'l-Hamd. And finally going whole
prophets and their nations and whom they are believing in their prophets going like this, coming in front of
entrance, and when Ridwaan (a), who is kapi bekliyim, the entrance of Paradise is under his control, he is
opening. First Rasoolullah (s) coming and Ridwaan (a) asking, “Who is coming?” They are saying, “Coming
Sayyidina Muhammad,” and Ridwaan (a) is saying, “Just I have been ordered not to open to anyone before
you, O Habeebullah!”
Huuu, Huuuu. Opening, and his nation and whole other nations beginning from Adam (a), they are on one
line when opening, no waiting for one to pass and second, but everyone just moving in it and everyone,
subhaanahu wa ta`ala, whole glory for the Lord of Heavens, making for everyone to come in and everyone
looking that he is putting his foot in his Paradise, finished! Everyone just entered to their Paradise, billions of
people at the same time, when the doors of Paradise opening and saying, “Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘rRaheem!” and everyone reaching and putting his foot into his Paradise, no one else there. That is his
territory! Allahu akbar, Allahu abkaral-akbar! Who is getting in, O Mankind, you must know that dirty feet
can’t put itself in Paradise, (only) clean feet may enter because there can’t be in Paradise any dirtiness and
never getting in a dirty foot, no!
O People! Clean yourselves; if you are not cleaning, you can't enter Paradise. Paradise is so pure, so clean,
that no one can put his dirty feet for entering. Therefore, billions of people will be taken to hells when they
are passing on the Bridge of Siraat. If not clean, paat, paat, paat, falling down to Fire for cleaning.
O People! Beware and take care not to go to Paradise with dirty feet. No, no, no! At least, O people, when you
are sleeping, wash your feet. Make a wudu and if you are passing night time not reaching morning they are
looking that one's feet just washed and angels dealing with him with another dealing. Allahu Akbar! Allah
Akbar! O Mankind! You are rolling, rolling in the dirtiness of this life and you are asking to get in Paradise.

Can't be! You should be cleaned until you are going in! Paradise is the place of clean people.
O our Lord! Let us to be clean ones in this world and to get out of this world clean. Where we can find clean
ones now? When you are going to wash a dead body there is coming a so-bad smelling. Oooh! Angels in that
grave (saying), "Come here! What is that dirtiness with you? You are not knowing how to clean yourself? We
shall clean you up to the Day of Resurrection. We are cleaning you. Bring fire from four jaanib, sides, and
coming fire, fire, fire. That is for you so that you will be clean up to the Day of Resurrection and this is first
cleanliness.
(... broadcast transmission cut to end, three minutes... )
Dome dome, dome dome, Dome dome, dome dome 4x
Fatihah.
